PRIVACY / RECONSTRUCTION RULES v2.0

1.  Public profile and private personal corpus are separate.
2.  Sensitive health/psychological data defaults to pseudonymous/private
    storage.
3.  Credentials/secrets are excluded from general backups.
4.  Every factual personal record should retain source/provenance and
    date where possible.
5.  Do not silently turn old travel/legal/medical answers into current
    facts.
6.  Do not infer identity, language, diagnosis or qualification from
    indirect signals.
7.  Preserve historical project mistakes because they are useful
    engineering provenance.
8.  Personal data can seed Workspaces and workflows; distributable Apps
    receive generalized schemas and de-identified/synthetic fixtures.
9.  Backup should be reconstructable without requiring the original chat
    history.
10. Unknown/unrecovered remains UNKNOWN rather than invented.
